notes.title: Poster Sticker is now also available in Simplified / Traditional Chinese!
notes.content:
We want the whole world to play our games. We therefore present you an update with a new language for poster stickers!
Poster Sticker is now also available in Simplified / Traditional Chinese!

notes.title: Poster Sticker is now fully available in Brazilian Portuguese!
notes.content:
We want the whole world to play our games. That is why our team, along with a new update, introduced a new language to Poster Sticker!
Poster Sticker is now fully available in Brazilian Portuguese! Play now!

notes.title: Poster Sticker has been officially released.
notes.content:
[b]Poster Sticker has been officially released![/b]
[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39760322/3686c717a96f563adbc961dadf343c05e7b8c61a.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39760322/3686c717a96f563adbc961dadf343c05e7b8c61a.png[/img][/url]
We’d also like to thank you all once again for supporting and sticking with us through this extended gap between updates. It means the world to us and we couldn’t be more grateful to have you by our side.
This truly has been the ride of a lifetime for us and we’re just getting started…

notes.title: Ready for release!!!
notes.content:
[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39760322/7f285f5a1eeef39d07c8f36f5f1916a85003d7e6.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39760322/7f285f5a1eeef39d07c8f36f5f1916a85003d7e6.png[/img][/url]
Hey you all!

Last week [b]Poster Sticker[/b] reached [i][u]"coming soon"[/u][/i] status so that game is waiting for getting released :)
The Steam page has finally been optimized suitable to the current state of the game.

We hope you are really looking forward to the release on [b]March, 2021![/b]

Thanks for your interested on [b]Poster Sticker[/b] and we're very excited what your feedback on the game will be!

notes.title: Our Steam Page is live!
notes.content:
[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39760322/c37d0d872bc2551290a20b40645f58b5684bbba3.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39760322/c37d0d872bc2551290a20b40645f58b5684bbba3.png[/img][/url]
Hello!

[h2]The Steam page for [b]"Poster Sticker"[/b] is finally here![/h2]
We're working day and night to bring this game to you as fast as we can.
Thanks again for all the support and stay tuned for more updates.
